actual.rootLog: Spring Security CsrfFilter rejected the machine request before CpfDomainInvocationGuard

rootCause: secure-api supplies Spring Security, but its resource-server chain is conditional; without an endpoint-scoped CPF chain, Boot's global default chain owns the internal Domain endpoint
requiredFix: Narrow stateless /_cpf/domain/** chain authorizing only verified CPF internal ingress, with CSRF disabled only for that machine endpoint; unrelated API security remains unchanged
prohibited: weakening the existing Header6 and operation guard
